reviews.review: Good.. no ifs no butts.... well, some butts

I wanted to recommend this game, but after what happened, I just can't...The character designs are awesome (warframe with jiggles) and feel unique in their mechanics, but once you get into late game, you quickly realize only a couple of characters are actually worth investing in. Couple that with the constant nerfs I witnessed in just 2-3 weeks of playtime and you realise the devs are looking for some kind of artificial difficulty to forge some reason for player to take longer to complete (honestly speaking) lack of content. Having a small roster and nerfing them constantly doesn't add up.

The real reason for the negative review, though, is the support team:

- A friend and I were playing this game pretty much every day. In the last two weeks alone, he put over 120 hours into it. We were even talking about spending real money on the game because we were having a good time. 

he then found out his account was linked to an old email address that no longer exists, contacted support to get it sorted out, and instead of helping, they closed his ticket without fixing anything. Now he's locked out of his account and all that progress is just gone and I still dont understand why he lost access to it only after telling them the e-mail no longer exists... maybe they looked into his expenditure of real money and once they saw he had spent 0 € in 2 weeks, they dicided it was easier to lock him out of the game over that.

Seeing that completely killed any interest I had in spending money on this game. If this is how they treat someone who invested over 120 hours in two weeks, why should I believe they'll help me if I ever have an account issue? They'd probably just close my ticket too and pretend nothing happened.

I can deal with balance issues. I can deal with a weak roster. What I can't deal with is a support team that acts like players don't matter. If the devs are okay with people losing their accounts because support can't be bothered to actually help, then they don't deserve my money or my recommendation.

Honestly this is exactly the game I was looking for. A chill game you and your homies can blast npc's all night as hot ass girls (Jiggle physics are a plus). Only downside is you can get hooked into buying stuff you dont need. However, this game can 100% be played without spending money and still be enjoyed.

Definitely a 7.5/10!

First and foremost, its a free to play Looter Shooter. The game loops a small handful of objectives (Defend this circle, Kill all enemies, follow this drone, collect the orbs, etc). Sometimes the mission is a combination of them, especially around halfway through the main game. 

As far as the F2P and Microtransactions go, this game has a very good balance compared to others. The store is definitely there, but its perfectly viable to never look at it and have a great time. One of the 3 starter characters you can play as, Ajax, can singlehandedly clear the entire base game without doing anything other than hitting "Use recommended modules". Also completing the MSQ gave me Ultimate Bunny, which is one of the strongest characters in the whole game ($50 if you wanted to buy it for some reason)

The game absolutely loves to shower you in gear. Following the in game guide rewards you with a handful of legendary weapons that honestly feel broken because of how strong they are. A Machine Gun with infinite ammo, a Sword that can almost One shot all base game bosses, a Submachine Gun that can hit a dozen enemies with lightning, along with several others.

At the time of review I've spent 27 hours in game. In that time i got 5 characters to max level, completed the MSQ, unlocked 2 farmed characters, and got to Battle Pass (free tier) level 65. I had the game instant crash on 3 different play sessions, with no warning. There may also be a small memory leak, after extended playing there would be stutters, FPS drops completely randomly. 95% of the time the game ran locked at 75FPS with my build at 1080p and most settings maxed. 

The only complaints i have about this game really are the "fan service" aspects. The character outfits you can purchase teeter on grossly sexualized. The in game chat can get very yucky at times too.
